openings.claim: Fixed plywood corner faces and end-stop tabs for both rods, seated before adjustable bolt clamping, could outperform visible tightness. Width changes clamp travel, not locating faces. Cord/elastic keepers must capture every movable part before rod release.
openings.discriminator: Against increased tightness in the same carrier, deliberate seating predicts smaller return errors, including with 18 mm replacement. Rival: overall tightness governs repeatability; awkward trials were incidental, so tighter does at least as well. Equal results do not discriminate; useful differences must exceed ruler resolution.
openings.probe: At most two configurations: datum seating with sufficient clamping versus increased tightness. Each: five exchanges per original rod, then two 18 mm substitutions in the smaller-rod seat; twelve total. Log displacement/time each exchange. Four ten-second 10 N lateral trials after exchanges 5, 10, 11, 12; record position throughout. Assess the supplied 2 mm target-circle, less-than-forty-second exchanges and loaded-position requirements. Do not deploy from this probe.
openings.uncertainty: No drilling, adhesive or permanent rod marks; hand-operated assembly/adjustment; 90 mm cube; nothing falls free. Frame geometry, bolt lengths, plywood stiffness, keeper reach and adjustable captive clamp capacity remain unverified. Only supplied six 80×40×6 mm plywood pieces, eight M5 bolts/nuts, four washers, two 150 mm elastic loops, 0.5 m cord and hand tools; drill plywood only. Fabrication ≤100 minutes and complete comparison ≤20 minutes are unproven. Defeats: insufficient travel, loose stops, plywood crushing, load slip or untethered parts. Reject construction if captivity/load resistance cannot be supplied; never relax constraints.

lineage.reason: Locating/clamping relation, rival, comparison, defeat conditions, uncertainty and declared uncertain fit preserved.

decision: Retain as unbuilt hypothesis. Current load motion is 7 mm; tighter returned 3 mm farther in two trials. Anomaly motivates, not establishes causation; square ends known only within 1 mm.
